about: Word lists for the `prose` docs gate (scripts/docs/gates/prose.mjs, spec 5.1 and A4.10). Matching is case-insensitive, on whole words (a hyphenated compound such as `just-in-time` is not the banned word), in reader-visible prose only: fences, HTML comments, inline code and link destinations are skipped. bannedWords are the spec 5.1 marketing words; aiTells are stock phrases of generated text. Add a phrase only when it has no neutral technical use in these docs.
aiTells: at the end of the day
